owner_policy.quote: nothing should be paid … cut the probes and make them free.
owner_policy.scope: This repo's own automation: anything a workflow, a script or an agent in this repository runs. The HeyGetOnMyLevel app's own inference (supabase/functions/generate-reading, on the Lovable AI gateway) is a separate named lane in config/product_inference.json, funded by the Lovable project's own credit, and is not governed by max_cost_usd.

policy.on_reported_cost: throw PaidCostError and fail the run

pricing_snapshot.selection: strongest general instruct models among the $0 list, largest context first. Excluded: google/lyria-3-* (music, and not :free so it can turn paid silently), nvidia/nemotron-3.5-content-safety:free (safety classifier), poolside/laguna-* and cohere/north-mini-code:free (code-only), liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b:free (sub-10B), openrouter/free (non-deterministic meta-router), nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free (listed but 404 on every call, 26 Oct 2026), and thinkingmachines/inkling*:free (403 "only available on agentic harnesses" on a sibling repo's first live dispatch, 11 Oct 2026). Refreshed 2026-11-03 for this repo: nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free was dropped because the live list no longer carries it (scripts/llm/free_router.mjs --check reported PRICING_CHANGED on it), the same removal how-we-know recorded on 2 Nov 2026. The three that remain were re-read as $0/$0 on the live list in this pass.

automation_lane.detail: No script or workflow in this repository calls a model. The Search Console collectors, the prerender and SEO checks, the IndexNow submitter, the entity backlink watch, the live check and the weekly outcome report are all deterministic. The router exists so that the first one to need a model has a $0 door to go through instead of naming its own. The repo's OPENROUTER_API_KEY secret is the key it would use.
